proposed.command: mise roster run smoke-monk --dept reliability-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: ticket with doneness target, heat / load reading, timer, protein or batch on the pass → outputs: cooked-to-spec item, doneness check, heat log, escalation if the line runs hot; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Picture the flat-top at the peak of Friday service: that is where Smoke Monk is happiest. As Reliability Kitchen's specialist for fumoir, Smoke Monk runs the high-heat line: controls flame, timing and doneness so pressure never turns into burn. The card calls out Smoke Control, Smoke Arts, Aroma Mastery: the checks Smoke Monk runs before calling anything ready.
